body:
The results are in!

  • 🥈2nd Place: @J_

Additionally, in order to help streamline the process (and because I just discovered this option😈) I'm doing sign-ups for the BYOG tournament tomorrow!

Sign up for tomorrow's BYOG pvp tournament here: https://bit.ly/4erFNhu
